title: Spring onion scrambled eggs on toast

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Butter, eggs, milk, cheddar, bread, spring onions and watercress are all plain home staples with no factory-made products.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: A frying pan, whisk, grater and toaster are ordinary kit, and scrambling eggs is beginner technique.

works.reason: Eight eggs, four slices of toast and a bunch of spring onions make a sensible breakfast for four, and gentle low-heat scrambling with cheese stirred in off the heat will come out soft and well seasoned.

honest_times.reason: Twelve minutes covers slicing the onions, grating the cheese, beating the eggs and toasting, and five minutes matches the 2-minute soften plus a quick scramble.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Spring onions are in season in March, star in the title and are both cooked into the eggs and scattered on top, which suits a warm breakfast.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English that a neighbour would follow easily.

hearty_healthy.reason: Eggs, cheese, wholemeal toast and watercress make a proper protein-rich breakfast a family would happily repeat.
